descriptor.name: Riga public cadastral parcel polygons
descriptor.operator: State Land Service of Latvia / Geolatvija
descriptor.scope: Public cadastral parcel geometry around the unchanged Riga WUP settlement locator. Thirteen aligned cells and 113 unique full parcels passed stable counts, complete paging, fresh native-ID geometry reads, correctly shaped explicit absence and full-parcel one-parcel binding. Root independent EPSG:3059 GEOS audit found no invalidity, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The WUP locator is covered by LV-VZD-01000210029. Evidence is bounded and does not establish citywide or nationwide completeness, survey precision, legal ownership or currentness.
descriptor.attribution: State Land Service of Latvia / Geolatvija · cadastral references · adapted
descriptor.licenceNote: Publisher conditions, legal effect and update schedule are informational. Public native parcel IDs and geometry only; ownership is not imported.
